Package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker

Class DataSourceDef

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker.DataSourceDef
public final class DataSourceDef extends Object
Declares a console data source: a browser loader that fetches rows from a same-origin URL, builds a columnar frame and publishes it on the topic data:<id>, which chart cards read with ChartDef.source(...).

Add it to a page with PageSpec.data(...). The declaration is checked when it is added: a bad URL, mode, chunking, column type or subscription role is E-76, and a bad parser or builder name is E-74.

Example:

page.data(DataSourceDef.create("orgRequests") .url("/rest/orgRequests/series").format(Format.CSV) .params(Subscription.to(Topics.filter("range")).as("params") .map("start", "start").map("end", "end")) .chunk(Chunking.byDay("start", "end")).cache(Cache.indexedDb()));

Since:
10.0.0
